beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Buddy finds existing real settings, saved records and work folders, including managed script profiles. A redesigned recovery screen helps when a choice or reconnection is needed.
• Grade and Verify share a floating page filmstrip with multi-page selection, rotation and reordering. Assignments and Chat/Rubric panels open by click and close with X.
• Empty Schoology-linked course cards open the course inside Buddy by default; Add PDF remains available for manual work.
• Simpler grading, appearance and AI settings, with text size beside the theme selector and guided local-model setup.
• Completion email settings and template editing are available from the Finalize bar, with clearer message previews.

Fixes:
• Recovery keeps original databases and settings, separates demo data from real work, and preserves offline work-folder locations.
• Settings Cancel restores unsaved choices; row transitions, verification controls and completion celebrations are smoother.
